test_title: PYST 04: SSC MTS 2024 - Numerical and Mathematical Ability (Held On: 07 Oct, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: By selling an article for ₹20, a dealer makes a profit of 10%. By how much should he increase his selling price (in ₹, rounded off to two decimal place) so as to make a profit of 50%?
solution:
**Given:**

Selling price (SP) = ₹20

Profit percentage = 10%

Desired profit percentage = 50%

**Formula Used:**

Cost Price (CP) = SP / (1 + Profit %)

New Selling Price (New SP) = CP × (1 + Desired Profit %)

Required increase in selling price = New SP - SP

**Calculation:**

CP = 20 / (1 + 10/100)

CP = 20 / 1.1

CP = 18.18

New SP = 18.18 × (1 + 50/100)

New SP = 18.18 × 1.5

New SP = 27.27

Required increase in SP = 27.27 - 20

Required increase in SP = 7.27

**The correct answer is option 2.**
